section_summary: Pages 34–37 finish an issue of the Bank of Japan’s Financial Statistics Monthly with tables on bonds, short-term securities and corporate capital, followed by its imprint. Pages 38–69 begin the February 1947 issue, with contents pages and statistical tables covering banks, credit cooperatives, insurers, government savings, securities trading and bill clearing.

people.name: Kitagawa Takenosuke
people.role: Editor and publisher named in the imprint

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, concluding tables and imprint
subfiles.about: Concluding tables report bond issues and redemptions, short-term securities and corporate capital.
subfiles.summary: The closing tables give monthly figures for government bonds, short-term securities, public and corporate debentures, planned capital and paid-up capital. The imprint records printing on March 20, 1947, and publication on March 25.

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, No. 11, February 1947
subfiles.about: The February issue compiles Japanese banking, insurance, public savings and securities statistics.
subfiles.summary: The cover, contents and graph introduce the February 1947 issue. Tables report Bank of Japan balances and the assets and liabilities of banks, trust companies, insurers, agricultural and urban credit cooperatives, mutual loan companies and specialized banks. Further tables cover the Deposit Bureau, postal savings, government insurance and pensions, securities trading, and cleared bills in Tokyo and Osaka. The issue continues beyond page 69.
